description: This file defines a Todo interface, a TodoFilter type, and a Todos class that manages a list of Todo items with methods for adding, deleting, updating, toggling, and filtering todos. It also includes a nanoid function for generating unique IDs.

classes.name: Todos
classes.description: A mutable, observable container for a todo list that fires change events on modifications.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new todo with specified text, generating a unique ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a todo by its ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates a todo's properties based on provided edits.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles the completion status of a todo by ID.

methods.name: toggleAll
methods.description: Toggles all todos' completion status based on current state.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Adds hashchange event listener to update filter.
